question: Did Seabreeze do any work on the land before the injunction?
expected: Their counter in O.S. 131/2025 (21.05.2025) says 'no construction activity whatsoever; only a survey'. But their plaint and PW1 in O.S. 57/2025 (10.12.2025) say they 'commenced preliminary works in April 2025'. VRO saw ~40 cement poles on 14.04.2025; DW1 admitted 'survey pegs and some poles' on 19.08.2026.

question: What should I expect from Murthy sir if the other side asks for time again?
expected: He says 'last opportunity' on the second request and imposes costs on the third (Greenfield: Rs 3,000 on 22.06.2026, cross closed). He also refuses irregular filings (Seabreeze SP 09.07.2025: Rs 2,000 costs; memo without copy rejected 11.03.2026).

question: Is Padmavathi madam strict about adjournments?
expected: No. She granted repeated time to Harinath without costs (14.05.2025), forgave our own missed summons on 25.03.2026, referred the friends' case to mediation, and gave the tenant extra time to deposit.
